title: FlagPole flag cleanup
description: Retire one fully rolled-out FlagPole flag in the fixed order from the remove-option-or-flag skill: collapse backend reads, collapse frontend reads, remove the automator block, then remove the registration. One run of the line = one flag; pass it to every gate as HAR_FLAG=organizations:<name>.

mcp.name: linear
mcp.why: the cleanup ticket is the traveler: values found in S0, PR links, deploy confirmations

stations.title: Preconditions
stations.description: No PR. Confirm the flag is temporary (not a plan entitlement in permanent.py), list every read with `git grep -n '<flag>' src tests static` and every value in sentry-options-automator options/default/flagpole.yaml at HEAD, and record the rolled-out outcome on the ticket. STOP and ask the human if the automator value is not a clean 100%/0%, is drifted, or getsentry reads the flag too — that is a product decision.

stations.title: Collapse backend reads (PR 1a)
stations.description: One slot, backend only: collapse every features.has / self.feature(...) read in src/ and tests/ to the outcome that won, delete the losing branch and everything only it reached. Keep the registration. If the flag has no backend reads, the station is a no-op and its gate passes.

stations.title: Collapse frontend reads (PR 1b)
stations.description: One slot, static/ only, started after PR 1a merged (the cumulative gate re-checks backend reads, so running it early fails): collapse organization.features.includes / <Feature> reads, delete the losing UI, gated routes and fixtures. Keep the registration.

stations.title: Remove the automator block (PR 2, other repo)
stations.description: Not in this repo and no HAR slot: remove the flag block from sentry-options-automator options/default/flagpole.yaml, only after PR 1a and 1b are DEPLOYED to all regions. Human merges and confirms the automator run is green. The gate is re-run here on a fresh slot to prove no read crept back in.

stations.title: Remove the registration (PR 3)
stations.description: One slot, backend: delete the manager.add(...) line from temporary.py (and any SENTRY_FEATURES default), only after S3 is deployed and green.

extraStages.description: Flag is not a permanent.py entitlement; warns on default=True
No read of HAR_FLAG left in src/ or tests/ (registration excluded)
No quoted read of the flag's short name left in static/
HAR_FLAG appears nowhere in src/, tests/, static/, fixtures/

handoff.waitFor: human review and merge of each PR, and confirmation that it is deployed to all regions before the next station starts

traveler.note: One comment per station on the cleanup ticket: S0 values found (automator default/regions), PR links, deploy confirmations. Squash merges drop commit footers, so the ticket is the record.

prototypeNotes: HAR_FLAG is per-run input, not program data: HAR_FLAG=organizations:my-feature har line gate S2 --line flag-cleanup --agent 3.
Merged is not deployed. Each station after S1 starts only when the previous PR is out everywhere — the gate cannot see deploys; the traveler records them.
reads-frontend matches any quoted occurrence of the short name in static/; a generic name (e.g. 'insights') can hit unrelated strings — list those in the handoff instead of renaming them.
getsentry reads are out of scope for this repo; S0 must ask whether getsentry reads the flag before S3.
